protocols.title: Taiwan · matched categorical generation
protocols.description: 80 assets, identical 1,500 test cases, five seeds.
protocols.finding: Read fidelity, coverage and portfolio diagnostics together.
protocols.limitations: Previously inspected periods; method-specific training budgets. Concurrent timing does not establish a speed ranking.

protocols.title: ABIDE · augmentation at a held-out site
protocols.description: 111 source labels (110 named regions and one unnamed label). Train: 349 subjects; validation: 92 Michigan subjects; test: 160 NYU subjects. Generator selection and classifier tuning use validation only.
protocols.finding: No established augmentation gain over real-only training.
protocols.limitations: One generator training seed; five generation seeds. Subject-bootstrap intervals condition on one site and fitted models. No clinical claim. Post-pilot atlas audit: unnamed two-voxel label 3455 alone caused 161 of 179 exclusions. Original pilot preserved.

protocols.title: ABIDE · five training replications
protocols.description: Same 111 source labels and subject/site splits. Each of five learned-model fits averages five generation draws.
protocols.finding: Inspect training variability and paired utility differences alongside average AUC.
protocols.limitations: Average AUC over five draws within each training seed, then mean/sample SD across five training seeds. Paired subject and joint training/subject bootstraps are conditional on this site, exploratory and unadjusted for multiplicity. Five generation draws are not independent training fits. The initial NYU results were known before expanding training seeds. No new site holdout. Post-pilot atlas audit: unnamed two-voxel label 3455 alone caused 161 of 179 exclusions; frozen population preserved.

protocols.title: Weather · future years in three regions
protocols.description: 64 cells per patch. Train 1981–2010; validate 2011–2015; test 2016–2024.
protocols.finding: Historical replay is a strong reference for aggregate dependence.
protocols.limitations: Nine year groups; regions and quarters are dependent. Unit local variance and reanalysis estimates; no forecast claim. Bootstrap ranges are descriptive and can be biased.

protocols.title: Weather · calibrated South America transfer
protocols.finding: Geographical transfer is harder in this pilot.
protocols.limitations: Nine year groups; regions and quarters are dependent. Unit local variance and reanalysis estimates; no forecast claim. Bootstrap ranges are descriptive and can be biased.

protocols.title: Temperature · exploratory learned generation
protocols.description: 64 cells; three regions and four quarters. Train 1981–2010, validation 2011–2015, test 2016–2024.
protocols.finding: DiffeoCFM improves on its Gaussian prior but does not beat replay or the conditional mean on aggregate-variance W1.
protocols.limitations: Exploratory inspected periods; one training seed. Generation SD is not uncertainty over future years. Structural SWD uses matched subsets of only nine matrices per condition; read utility separately.

protocols.title: Legacy archive · unconditional validation diagnostic
protocols.description: 80D precomputed matrix archive without dates or asset identities. One full 50-epoch reference reconstruction; 300 fixed validation cases, no conditioning.
protocols.finding: The full reference training budget completed but does not reproduce realistic archive distributions.
protocols.limitations: Validation selected the model; these are diagnostic scores. Generation SD does not replicate training. No conditional or faithful original-training result is claimed.

protocols.title: ABIDE · 110 named regions · same601
protocols.description: Re-estimated OAS targets. 349 training, 92 Michigan validation and 160 NYU test subjects. Simple controls; no learned fits.
protocols.finding: Replay and Gaussian augmentation establish no gain.
protocols.limitations: Five generation draws, not training replications; 1000 paired diagnosis-stratified subject draws, conditional on fitted models and one site, unadjusted for multiple comparisons. Previously inspected sites. Compare cohorts separately; common-subject results are in evidence.

protocols.title: ABIDE · 110 named regions · expanded762
protocols.description: Re-estimated OAS targets. 488 training, 108 Michigan validation and 166 NYU test subjects. Simple controls; no learned fits.
protocols.finding: Replay and Gaussian augmentation establish no gain.
protocols.limitations: Five generation draws, not training replications; 1000 paired diagnosis-stratified subject draws, conditional on fitted models and one site, unadjusted for multiple comparisons. Previously inspected sites. Compare cohorts separately; common-subject results are in evidence.
